'''The River''' was a boulevard located in the [[Off-Worlders' Quarter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ropagi II]]. It was lined on either side by [[Cantina|bars]] and [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]]. [[Droid/Legends|Droids]] were not welcome in the majority of the establishments along the River.<ref name="Ropagi II" />
